name: crew-watch
description: Live panel of subagents and background jobs that flags anything stuck repeating itself, and wakes Claude to deal with it.

stuckMinutes.title: Minutes before a job or agent counts as stuck
stuckMinutes.description: A background job with no new output, or a running subagent with no activity, for this long is flagged.

wakeClaude.title: Wake Claude when a background job gets stuck
wakeClaude.description: Queues a prompt telling Claude to check the job, kill it if it is spinning, and change approach.
